notes: «كلاهما عن ابن جريج، عن عطاء، عن جابر» is written once for the first two branches (علي بن مسهر and ابن علية); it is written out for each of them here, since the third branch («وحدثني محمد بن حاتم») repeats its own names and does not take that tail
«- واللفظ له -» is an editor gloss and is left out
«قلت لعطاء قال جابر حتى جئنا المدينة» is Ata's clarification of the same saying from Jabir, not a second isnad: left out as a route
The third branch's saying names جابر بن، عبد الله (the comma is kept as written)
